usedFor: Finance teams file expenses in Expensify, where “Create Report” starts a new expense report for an employee.

bestTemplate.name: “New Project” in FreeAgent, then “Create Report” in Expensify
bestTemplate.why: A new project gets its own expense report for an employee, so costs have a place from day one.

watchOut: “Create Report” in Expensify makes a report for an employee, so check which employee an earlier step passes.
